limitations: Timings exclude synthetic inference, root initialization, tracing, and result export.
The main and compact-isolation sweeps use eight root candidates; a separate focused check uses min(53, simulation budget).
Small single-thread controls include approximately 3.3% regressions; this is not a universal speedup.
Two AB/BA pairs with two measured repeats per arm and case, plus one warmup per worker case; no statistical confidence interval or fleet-weighted result is claimed.
Original serial/unconditional parallel screening used the earlier uncached Python fixture; it motivated rejection and is not pooled into final results.
The incomplete large sweep was terminated to fix repeated Python CSR export work outside the timed regions; it did not produce a final qualified report.
